description: This file defines the PlaywrightConnection class responsible for managing remote connections in the Playwright testing framework, including message handling, connection lifecycle, and cleanup procedures.

classes.name: PlaywrightConnection
classes.description: Manages a remote Playwright connection, handling message dispatch, connection lifecycle, and cleanup.

methods.name: _onDisconnect
methods.description: Handles cleanup and disconnection procedures when the connection is closed or encounters an error.

methods.name: logServerMetadata
methods.description: Logs metadata about messages sent and received for debugging purposes.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the connection, optionally with a reason.
